li.label: night owl
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is most alive in the hours others sleep. The dark is not a wall for {PAWN_objective}; it is a workshop where {PAWN_possessive} hands work while the world rests.

li.label: early riser
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} greets the dawn before the world wakes. The quiet first light is where {PAWN_possessive} morning begins, sharp and clear.

li.label: health nut
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} treats the body as a temple. Fresh food, clean water, measured effort - {PAWN_pronoun} keeps {PAWN_possessive} body resilient against whatever the rim throws at it.

li.label: glutton
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} cannot resist a full plate, no matter the cost. Rations, preserves, the last of {PAWN_possessive} food - {PAWN_pronoun} eats it all, and the hunger returns quickly.

li.label: meditator
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} sits in stillness and lets the noise of the colony fall away. What disturbs others merely passes over {PAWN_objective} like wind over stone.

li.label: gym rat
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} spends every spare moment training. Iron discipline has turned {PAWN_possessive} body into a weapon, hard and unforgiving.

li.label: bookworm
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} is never far from a book. {PAWN_possessive} mind, fed by constant study, reaches for answers faster than most.

li.label: musician
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} fills the colony with music. Rhythms and melodies follow {PAWN_objective} through the day, softening even the hardest of lives.

li.label: tactician
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} sees every situation as a board to be won. A love of games has sharpened {PAWN_possessive} mind into a precise instrument of planning.
